entries.proposition: The text names eight registered trials (all with an NCT number) and none is a WWOX trial; ClinicalTrials.gov searched by condition WWOX or WOREE on 2026-10-20 returns one record each time, a general rare-disease registry and not a gene-replacement study, and the term WWOX plus AAV returns none. The Table 1 phrase is therefore not supported by the registry as queried and by this review; the preclinical WWOX gene-therapy papers in this repository describe a trial as future work.
entries.snippet: There are currently no FDA-approved gene therapies directly targeting monogenic epilepsies where epilepsy is the only or primary symptom, but there are several for syndromes that include epilepsy as a comorbidity.
